# Lab 17.6: Stream Sharing with Pub/Sub Listings

## What We Are Going to Do
Share a live Pub/Sub topic through a listing so a partner can subscribe to real-time events.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a topic to share.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics create lab17-live-orders</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create a stream listing.** In your exchange, click **Create listing → Resource type: Pub/Sub topic**, choose `lab17-live-orders`, name it `Live Orders Stream`, and publish.

3. **[Console] Subscribe from the partner project.** In the partner project, open the listing and click **Subscribe**. This creates a Pub/Sub subscription in the partner project linked to your topic.

4. **[CLI] Publish and receive.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics publish lab17-live-orders --message='{"order_id": 1, "city": "Surat"}'
gcloud pubsub subscriptions list --project=$PARTNER
gcloud pubsub subscriptions pull &lt;PARTNER_SUBSCRIPTION&gt; --project=$PARTNER --auto-ack</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Revoke access.** Remove the partner's subscriber role. Their subscription stops receiving messages.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Shared resource | Pub/Sub topic |
| Partner | Gets its own subscription |
| Latency | Real time |
| Control | Revoke at any time |
